The photon energy used in the experiment

A doubling of the effective mass

Topological invariant of the crystal lattice in real space
Spin polarization vector along the magnetic easy axis

Photon energy of the probe pulse

Static dielectric constant of the vacuum
Thermal vibrations of the adsorbate molecule
Doppler shift from the molecular motion

The electron inelastic mean free path

Magnetic fields and neutron orbital angular momentum
The strong nuclear force and neutron interference

o: The area vector of the interferometer loop
The direction of the neutron beam polarization
The magnetic field vector of the Earth

o: Slight mass-like term due to the transverse confinement and orbital angular momentum

o: Multipole transition selection rules of the target (Delta l = +/- topological charge, etc.)
Thermal velocity of the target atoms
Work function of the target material

q: In 4D ultrafast electron microscopy (UEM), a femtosecond laser pulse excites the sample and a delayed electron pulse probes the dynamics via imaging or diffraction. o: Rate of change of the electron's kinetic energy, related to the chirp rate in the time domain
De Broglie wavelength of the electrons

q: In quantum state reconstruction of a free electron wave function, the Wigner distribution tomography technique uses a series of measurements of the electron density after propagation through a variable focusing element. o: Phase-space tomography in optics, but applied to matter waves

o: h_bar / (2m), unique for each particle mass

o: Phase of the internal oscillation and the phase of the external wave

Electric charge and the magnetic moment

o: E = h_bar*omega and p = h_bar*k, the fundamental equations of wave mechanics
The Lorentz force law for electromagnetism

o: Non-locality and the instantaneous change in the quantum potential upon absorption of the photon by the wave field

Thermal fluctuation of the electron energy

o: The modification of the meter's momentum uncertainty, connected to the imaginary part of the momentum in the barrier

o: The Hawking temperature analogue in a sonic black hole formed in the condensate

The Dingle temperature of the quantum oscillations

Photoelectric emission from the undulator magnets

Photoelectric emission from the magnetic domains

Photon wavelength to the electron wavelength

Chemical bonding with the surface atoms

Mean free path of the particles
Thermal de Broglie wavelength at the initial temperature
Photon wavelength of the cooling laser
